notes:
Crash fixes
- On macOS 27.2, reading text in your footage (OCR) and the Apple scoring behind the soft-focus check stopped working. Both work again.
- On macOS 27.2, opening a project, Check for Updates and several Maintenance actions closed Cut Valet straight away. The cause was the spinning wait cursor Cut Valet put up, which macOS 27.2 refuses to draw. Cut Valet no longer shows its own wait cursor on a Mac (macOS shows its beach ball when an app is busy).
- The Projects page could close Cut Valet when its project list refreshed while you were clicking or dragging a project card. Cards now wait for your click or drag to finish before they are replaced.
- Send Diagnostics now includes the system's own crash reports (macOS crash reports, Windows error reports), with your home folder and user name removed, so a crash can be traced from the first bundle.

Projects and Resolve
- When Resolve has a different project open, Adopt, Rescan and Resync now ask before working, naming both projects: Switch, Continue or Cancel.
- Settings > Maintenance > Find clips from other projects lists clips in a project that belong to another one.
- An adoption can be removed from a project from its row in Sources, and Clean up ingest log can cover the whole library.
- Clips whose drive moved are relinked when the same file sits at the same place on the new drive, and on a Mac Cut Valet tells apart two drives with the same name.
- Resolve installed on an external drive is now found on a Mac.

Clips
- Move to Trash from a clip's menu sends the file to the Trash (never deletes it outright), takes it off Cut Valet's own time-of-day timelines and out of the Media Pool, and lists any other timeline that used it.
- Sideways phone clips are turned upright everywhere a clip is placed, including Place at playhead, and the turn follows the timeline's own fit or crop-to-fill setting.
- Several cameras of the same Sony model that do not report a serial number are told apart by the file name prefix you set on each body.

Reliability
- Renders, Deliver exports, Generate Proxies, YouTube uploads and long AI agent jobs now keep the computer awake (and, on a Mac, out of App Nap) until they finish.
- On a Mac, when transcription has to move from the GPU to the CPU, Cut Valet says so once instead of just getting slower.

Settings
- The Default frame rate list now offers 120, matching New Project.
- Settings > Accounts & Services has an Epidemic Sound row that shows whether your key is saved and takes you straight to where it is entered.

Your AI agent (MCP)
- Headless Cut Valet keeps a current project, every project tool takes a project_id, and run_jobs runs the work it queues.
